back_translation: Thus says the LORD: For three transgressions of Moab, or for four, I will not hold back the punishment, because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime.
I will send fire upon Moab, and it will consume the citadels of Kerioth; Moab will die amid tumult, amid shouting and the sound of the trumpet.
I will cut off the ruler from her midst and slay all her officials with him, says the LORD.

Thus says the LORD: For three transgressions of Judah, or for four, I will not hold back the punishment, because they rejected the law of the LORD and did not keep His statutes; their lies led them astray, after which their fathers had walked.
I will send fire upon Judah, and it will consume the citadels of Jerusalem.
Thus says the LORD: For three transgressions of Israel, or for four, I will not hold back the punishment, because they sell the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals.
They trample the heads of the poor into the dust of the earth and push the oppressed out of the way; a father and his son go to the same girl, profaning My holy name.
They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge, and in the house of their God they drink wine taken as fines.
Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them, who was as tall as the cedars and as strong as the oaks; I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below.
It was I who brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you through the wilderness forty years, to take possession of the land of the Amorite.
I raised up some of your sons to be prophets and some of your young men to be Nazirites. Is this not so, O Israelites? declares the LORD.
But you made the Nazirites drink wine, and you commanded the prophets, saying, 'Do not prophesy.'
Behold, I will crush you down in your place, as a cart loaded full with sheaves presses down.
The swift will not escape, the strong will not be able to summon his strength, and the warrior will not save his life.
The archer will not stand his ground, the swift of foot will not escape, and the horseman will not save his life.
Even the bravest among the warriors will flee naked on that day, declares the LORD.
